item.title: President Bostic Speaks at the Rotary Club of Atlanta
item.description: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic shares his economic viewpoint during a moderated discussion and Q&A with former Bank president Dennis Lockhart.

item.title: President Bostic Speaks at Annual Economic Outlook Event
